how_to_read.speaker: the player character whose secret backstory this is: the upload's speaker
how_to_read.knowers: who knows the row before anything public names it: a list of names (player characters, or an NPC with a point of view), "party" (all four player characters), "everyone" (common knowledge) or "dm" (nobody: a real secret, not even the speaker). A row with no knowers field is known to the speaker alone. An event between two characters is known to both ends (#4523 ruling C)
how_to_read.tier: stated = the words are in the text; inferred = only implied (offered to the DM as a suggestion, never extracted as a fact)
how_to_read.must_find: false = a good find if present, not a miss if absent
how_to_read.current: false = history: it was true and is not now
how_to_read.line: the line of the document's plain-text export that supports it (blank lines count)
how_to_read.revealed: which public lore rows (lore_key.json) state the same thing; listed there too, under reveals
how_to_read.threads: kind quest, hook or mystery; taker = whose own pursuit it is; same_as = the lore key's thread for the same story
